ACT XII OF 1996
ACT XII OF 1996
SINDH PUBLIC CONVEYANCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act to amend the Sindh Public
Conveyances Act, 1920
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-IV, 24th April, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-3/96, dated
24-4-1996.--The Sindh Public Conveyances (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 11th April, 1996 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 24th April, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Public Conveyances (Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of sections 22 to 28 of Sindh Act VII of 1920

ACT XII OF 1996
ACT XII OF 1996
SINDH PUBLIC CONVEYANCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act to amend the Sindh Public
Conveyances Act, 1920
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-IV, 24th April, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-3/96, dated
24-4-1996.--The Sindh Public Conveyances (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 11th April, 1996 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 24th April, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of sections 22 to 28 of Sindh Act VII of 1920.--In the
Sindh Public Conveyances Act, 1920:--
(i) in section 22, for the words
"one hundred", the words "one thousand" shall be
substituted;
(ii) in sections 23 and 24 for
the word "fifty", the words "five hundred" shall be
substituted;
(iii) in sections 25, 27 and 28,
for the word "twenty" the words "two hundred fifty" shall
be substituted;
(iv) in section 26, for the word
"thirty", the words "three hundred" shall be substituted:
